q.line: I pulled off into a forest
stanza: I pulled off into a forest
Crickets clicking in the ferns
Like a wheel of fortune
I heard my fate turn, turn, turn
And I went running down a white sand road
I was running like a white-assed deer
Running to lose the blues
To the innocence in here
These are the clouds of Michelangelo
Muscular with gods and sun gold
Shine on your witness in the refuge of the roads

q.line: He has missed her in the forest
stanza: He has missed her in the forest
While he showed her all the flowers
And the branches sang the chorus
As he climbed the scaly towers of a forest tree
While she was somewhere being free

partner.line: And the branches sang the chorus

q.line: Appear and disappear in the forest
stanza: Sad music in the night
Sings a scream of light out of chorus
And voices you might hear
Appear and disappear in the forest
Short and tall, throw the ball
And my name is Carnival

partner.line: Sings a scream of light out of chorus

q.line: And I am the fire, and I am the forest
stanza: Today, I will wear my white button-down
I'm tired of wanting more, I think I'm finally worn
For you have a way of promising things
And I've been a forest fire, I am a forest fire
And I am the fire, and I am the forest
And I am a witness watching it
I stand in a valley watching it
And you are not there at all

partner.line: I'm tired of wanting more, I think I'm finally worn
